_comment: Mutation testing (Stryker) proves the UNIT suite actually catches bugs, per docs/engineering/ENGINEERING_EXCELLENCE.md. Scoped to the PURE recipe domain + service logic that unit tests exercise; uses vitest.config.ts (unit only — integration/e2e specs need Docker and are excluded from that config, so they never run here). A surviving mutant = a bug the tests can't see; drive them to zero.
